criteria.requirement: Validate Document.add_comment supplied Run or nonempty Run iterable BEFORE creating comments/relationships/markers. Every provided Run belongs to current main document part and XML tree; reject foreign/header/footer/detached/unsupported textbox story, reverse/duplicate/non-Run/empty ranges. Preserve single Run and ordered cross-paragraph first/last range semantics (unprovided intervening runs naturally included), author/initials. Failures leave both documents and comments part absent/unmodified, no only-after-allocation check.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
